default.description: Mockingbird default capability set. Grants every Tauri-declared window the core permission bundle (event:listen/emit, window:show/hide/close, webview:*, app:*, etc.). Without this file present, capabilities.json is empty and listen() / window.hide() / emit_to() callbacks silently no-op while invoke() of #[tauri::command] handlers still works — the exact failure mode of mb-z5y wave-1 + wave-2 (ADR 0034, 0035).
